recommendation: Keep this fix. It completes the already-approved safety checklist addition across the current formal CodeSystem surface without changing unrelated checklist/code-system mismatches.
issue_request: FHIR-25265 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked that the safety checklist cover paging concerns: clients should check for Bundle.link next-page links in search results so applications do not miss clinically relevant data, and servers should document sort and paging concurrency behavior.
initial_application: Git commit cd4d7e53daa7946439cdf2cb1f3e82d9c183aabb added search-pages-client and search-pages-server items to source/safety.html, matching the Jira request. It did not add corresponding concepts to the active safety-entries CodeSystem.
additional_context: source/safety.html says the checklist is also available as a CodeSystem for formal references, and source/fhir.ini actively includes source/codesystem/codesystem-safety-entries.xml under [codesystems]. FHIR-I minutes for 2020-04-13 confirm the Persuasive 10-0-0 decision. Corrected Zulip searches for the issue key and paging safety checklist terms found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Added search-pages-client and search-pages-server concepts to source/codesystem/codesystem-safety-entries.xml using the same client/server paging guidance already present in source/safety.html.
